description: This file defines a class 'Functions' in the 'Matrix' namespace, which provides various static methods for matrix operations such as validation, adjoint, cofactors, determinant, diagonal, antidiagonal, identity, inverse, minors, trace, and transpose. The methods handle matrices represented as instances of the 'Matrix' class or arrays, and include error handling via exceptions.

classes.name: Functions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for matrix calculations such as adjoint, cofactor, determinant, etc., with validation and error handling.

methods.name: validateMatrix
methods.description: Ensures that the input is a Matrix object; creates a new Matrix if input is an array.

methods.name: getAdjoint
methods.description: Calculates the adjoint (adjugate) of a square matrix.

methods.name: adjoint
methods.description: Public method to return the adjoint of a matrix, validating that it is square.

methods.name: getCofactors
methods.description: Calculates the cofactor matrix of a given matrix.

methods.name: cofactors
methods.description: Public method to compute cofactors, validating the input matrix.

methods.name: getDeterminantSegment
methods.description: Computes the determinant of a submatrix obtained by removing a specified row and column.

methods.name: getDeterminant
methods.description: Recursively computes the determinant of a square matrix.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Public method that validates and returns the determinant of a matrix.

methods.name: diagonal
methods.description: Extracts the main diagonal as a new matrix.

methods.name: antidiagonal
methods.description: Extracts the anti-diagonal as a new matrix.

methods.name: identity
methods.description: Creates an identity matrix of the same size as the input matrix.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of a square matrix, throws exception if determinant is zero.

methods.name: getMinors
methods.description: Calculates all minors of a matrix.

methods.name: minors
methods.description: Public method to compute the minors of a matrix.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Calculates the sum of the main diagonal elements.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Returns the transpose of a matrix.
